partition.oct02_caveat: Oct02 is schema 9 on the target server (eu.gamester.org, 547ms ping); aimbot_engaged and rotation_active are false on 100% of ticks. Its speed tail is genuinely heavier (p99 32.3 vs 17.5, max 168.9 vs 62.5 deg/tick) and is real player aim, NOT a teleport - RotationRecorder only accumulates teleport_jumps/max_speed while rotationActive, so those summary fields are always 0 for manual files.

by_speed.method: 9-tick windows fully inside one speed bin (all deltas); linear detrend below 1.5 deg/tick (floor-compatible), quadratic above; sparse (<30 windows) carry the previous bin
